name: mcp-cli-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is mcp-cli, a command-line client for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers: it
connects to MCP servers, lets a language model call their tools, and offers chat, interactive and direct-command modes
with a shared slash-command system, server configuration, secure token storage and multi-modal file attachments.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The code in scope is mcp-cli's configuration, command, token and attachment layer: the packages src/mcp_cli/config/, src/mcp_cli/memory/, src/mcp_cli/utils/ and src/mcp_cli/auth/, the modules src/mcp_cli/chat/attachments.py and src/mcp_cli/tools/config_loader.py, the command framework modules directly inside src/mcp_cli/commands/ (__init__.py, base.py, decorators.py, enums.py, exceptions.py, registry.py, types.py and utils.py) and the command packages src/mcp_cli/commands/core/, src/mcp_cli/commands/tokens/, src/mcp_cli/commands/attach/, src/mcp_cli/commands/theme/, src/mcp_cli/commands/tools/, src/mcp_cli/commands/servers/ and src/mcp_cli/commands/usage/. The documentation in scope is: docs/COMMANDS.md, docs/TOKEN_MANAGEMENT.md and docs/ATTACHMENTS.md, together with the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement g
